I’m honestly a bit surprised by how low some of the reviews are. I’ve been with this GP for a while now (5 years), and over the last few years they’ve clearly made changes. The service is now genuinely top-notch.

Everyone I’ve dealt with has been great: doctors, nurses, reception, admin staff. All very professional, approachable, and always trying their best to help. Whenever I’ve needed support, especially at difficult moments, they’ve always been there for me.

Of course, there will always be people exaggerating bad experiences, but from my experience these NHS professionals really do care and try their hardest to help patients. I’m very grateful for the service they provide and couldn’t ask for more.

Highly recommended.",null,[0,83]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pGdmNYaDFUVXhyTW5KdVUwWnhTSEV3YzFCNGVWRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x3ef2ee7a3111b1bb!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOjFvcXh1TUxrMnJuU0ZxSHEwc1B4eVE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pGdmNYaDFUVXhyTW5KdVUwWnhTSEV3YzFCNGVWRRAB&t=1&-KgswZFFvcVRJQjlVNg&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjJ_cHk-q6TAxXoMGMBHW4eBVQQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjJ_cHk-q6TAxXoMGMBHW4eBVQQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMUZzVDAweVQxOWZSV2hDTjBZd1ZGWk9kREZwWW1FME4wVnRZMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSUVVOYVExVTBlbGswV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2w5RlUwOXZXWGt4VHpRek1GQlhUMkZYUkZGMlUyYxAB",["0x0:0x3ef2ee7a3111b1bb",null,1767436220734350,1767436220734350,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113721723244978163530/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Andrea S.","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXxkI342cKiKAskDAYK0ocx1FIwOXNuX8qx9GnOCk7kjD7oOpQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113721723244978163530?hl=en"],"113721723244978163530",null,38,84,null,[1,5,1],117,["Local Guide · 38 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjJ_cHk-q6TAxXoMGMBHW4eBVQQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"2 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["The changes from the past couple of years have been life saving!
